review:
Rise of Giza PowerNudge is a 10-payline Egyptian slot built on Pragmatic's PowerNudge mechanic, where winning reels nudge down to give the next symbols a chance to win too.

The scarab lands as a scatter overlay; collecting three triggers the free spins. In the bonus a progressive multiplier starts and increases by 1x with every nudge and every following free spin, so long sequences get steadily more valuable. Pragmatic lists a 96.49% RTP. It suits players who like simple line slots with one feature that keeps building.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
